title: Fintech & Payments
tagline: Payment gateways, wallets, banking, and fintech APIs
description: Nepal's payment landscape — eSewa and Khalti dominate consumer wallets, while ConnectIPS/NCHL operate the rails. Khalti has the most polished cross-platform official SDK story; community SDKs fill gaps for the rest. Cryptocurrency is illegal in Nepal — no crypto integrations are listed.

resources.name: eSewa Developer Portal
resources.description: ePay v2 (web redirect, Android, iOS). UAT at uat.esewa.com.np with test merchant EPAYTEST. Nepal's largest digital wallet, 8M+ users.

resources.name: Khalti Developer Docs
resources.description: KPG2 single-integration aggregating wallet + eBanking + ConnectIPS + SCT/VISA. The most polished official multi-platform SDK story in Nepal.

resources.name: Khalti GitHub
resources.description: 43 repos: Web SDK, Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native checkout SDKs + WooCommerce/OpenCart/WHMCS plugins.

resources.name: IME Pay Developer Portal
resources.description: Official IME Pay merchant SDK — Android (imepay/imepaySDK_android), iOS, Flutter (pub.dev/packages/imepay_merchant_sdk).

resources.name: ConnectIPS / NCHL
resources.description: NRB-promoted real-time payments network. Operates NEPALPAY QR, NEPALPAY card scheme, RPS, RTGS. Docs at doc.connectips.com.

resources.name: Fonepay
resources.description: Nepal's largest payment network — 1.3M+ stores, 60+ partners, 20M+ customers. No public dev portal; sandbox at dev-clientapi.fonepay.com. Java/Spring sample at fonepay/Fonepay-Spring-Boot-Integration-Sample.

resources.name: fonepay_flutter (community)
resources.description: Community Flutter SDK for Fonepay integration.

resources.name: @arbyte/fonepay (Node)
resources.description: Community Node.js SDK for Fonepay integration.

resources.name: SmartChoice Technology (SCT)
resources.description: First Nepali switching network (2001). SCT-Network ATM/POS; Smart QR with 160k+ merchants.

resources.name: voidarchive/nepal-payment-go
resources.description: Go SDK supporting eSewa, Khalti, ConnectIPS, and Fonepay in one package. MIT-licensed, January 2026 release.

resources.name: manibibek/payment-gateways-in-nepal
resources.description: Canonical reference repo for Nepali payment-gateway integrations.

resources.name: remotemerge/esewa-php-sdk
resources.description: Community PHP SDK for eSewa ePay v2.

resources.name: C-KYC (CDSC)
resources.description: Capital-market centralized KYC operated by CDSC.

resources.name: Office of Controller of Certification (OCC)
resources.description: Nepal's Root Certifying Authority for digital signatures.

resources.name: NRB NPS Master Reference Document 2025
resources.description: Roadmap for the full National Payment Switch and open-banking direction (2025). See nrb.org.np/contents/uploads/2025/10/.
